name: Dice FM API
tagline: Music events and ticketing platform API for club/festival listings
description: Dice FM provides a partner-focused API for discovering live music events, venues, and ticketing data across clubs and festivals. Access is primarily partner/self-serve for developers integrating event listings and ticket flows.

auth.details: API key authentication; partner/self-serve developer access

use_cases: list upcoming club nights in a city
get venue details for a music event
check ticket availability for an event
